name: No off-domain drift on bare greeting
success_condition: The reply must NOT mention healthcare benefits, insurance, coverage, a plan, a claim or a claim number, and must not ask for the user full name. A plain greeting is acceptable; steering toward puberty or menstrual health is also acceptable.

success_examples.response: Sasa! Karibu. Una swali gani kuhusu kukua, mwili wako au hedhi?
Hi! Good to hear from you. What would you like to know about your body or your periods?
Hello there! How can I help you today?

failure_examples.response: Sasa! How can I help you today with your healthcare benefits? Are you wondering about what your plan covers, or maybe about a claim?
Can I get your full name and claim number to look that up?
